requests.description: Generate random bytes using the Cloud KMS randomness source in the provided location.
requests.name: POST /v1/{location}:generateRandomBytes
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Update a CryptoKeyVersion's metadata. state may be changed between ENABLED and DISABLED using this method. See DestroyCryptoKeyVersion and RestoreCryptoKeyVersion to move between other states.
requests.name: PATCH /v1/{name}

requests.description: Returns the public key for the given CryptoKeyVersion. The CryptoKey.purpose must be ASYMMETRIC_SIGN or ASYMMETRIC_DECRYPT.
requests.name: GET /v1/{name}/publicKey
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Decrypts data that was encrypted with a public key retrieved from GetPublicKey corresponding to a CryptoKeyVersion with CryptoKey.purpose ASYMMETRIC_DECRYPT.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:asymmetricDecrypt
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Signs data using a CryptoKeyVersion with CryptoKey.purpose ASYMMETRIC_SIGN, producing a signature that can be verified with the public key retrieved from GetPublicKey.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:asymmetricSign
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Decrypts data that was protected by Encrypt. The CryptoKey.purpose must be ENCRYPT_DECRYPT.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:decrypt
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Schedule a CryptoKeyVersion for destruction. Upon calling this method, CryptoKeyVersion.state will be set to DESTROY_SCHEDULED, and destroy_time will be set to the time destroy_scheduled_duration in the future. At that time, the state will automatically change to DESTROYED, and the key material will be irrevocably destroyed. Before the destroy_time is reached, RestoreCryptoKeyVersion may be called to reverse the process.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:destroy
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Encrypts data, so that it can only be recovered by a call to Decrypt. The CryptoKey.purpose must be ENCRYPT_DECRYPT.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:encrypt
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Signs data using a CryptoKeyVersion with CryptoKey.purpose MAC, producing a tag that can be verified by another source with the same key.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:macSign
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Verifies MAC tag using a CryptoKeyVersion with CryptoKey.purpose MAC, and returns a response that indicates whether or not the verification was successful.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:macVerify
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Restore a CryptoKeyVersion in the DESTROY_SCHEDULED state. Upon restoration of the CryptoKeyVersion, state will be set to DISABLED, and destroy_time will be cleared.
requests.name: POST /v1/{name}:restore
requests.note: Replace {{CLOUD_KEY_MANAGEMENT_SERVICE_KMS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Update the version of a CryptoKey that will be used in Encrypt. Returns an error if called on a key whose purpose is not ENCRYPT_DECRYPT.

requests.description: Import wrapped key material into a CryptoKeyVersion. All requests must specify a CryptoKey. If a CryptoKeyVersion is additionally specified in the request, key material will be reimported into that version. Otherwise, a new version will be created, and will be assigned the next sequential id within the CryptoKey.

requests.description: Returns permissions that a caller has on the specified resource. If the resource does not exist, this will return an empty set of permissions, not a `NOT_FOUND` error.
